optOuts.reason: Registry's lookup fast path reads the load-time issecretvalue probe directly, once for both arguments; the shared block keeps the probe inside its do block, so converting would add two calls to every Get and Find.
CommandKit asks ClientKit's secret probe first, which the shared probe does not do; its owner decides when that changes.
HookKit compares the receiver with rawequal; its owner decides whether to take the shared type-first form.
